lines.text: Many learners say: I do not have many money.
Better: I do not have much money.
Money is not counted. Use much.
Much! We do not have much time.

data.wrong: I do not have many money.
data.right: I do not have much money.
data.why: Money is not counted. Use much.

native.tip: Деньги не считаем штуками — говори “much money”.

en.tip: Money is not counted by pieces — say “much money”.
en.caption: Do you also say “I do not have many money.”? 😅 You cannot count money by pieces, so use “much”, not “many”. Correct: “I do not have much money.”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
